The universal assertion is not supported, but an unqualified contradicted score would bypass those requirements.
limitations: This procedural unresolved result does not endorse the universal assertion.
A single matching counterexample would defeat universality; losses at several large labs would not establish it.

statement.excerpt: Every single AI business you see is unprofitable, nor do any of them have a path to break-even, let alone sustainability.
statement.document_title: Am I Meant To Be Impressed?

from_speaker: nor do any of them have a path to break-even
our_interpretation: The ordinary reading covers businesses selling AI models and AI applications, not merely OpenAI and Anthropic.
Profitable means the business earns more than its total expenses; revenue growth and positive gross margin alone do not establish this.
A path to break-even means a substantiated operating plan with plausible revenue, cost, and financing assumptions, rather than a forecast date alone.
Use January–March 2026, the latest completed calendar quarter before publication, for the ongoing profitability observation.
The words do not identify GAAP, non-GAAP, company-reported, or estimated profitability. The accounting basis remains unknown rather than being supplied by the evaluator.
criteria.support_condition: Evidence covering the claimed population establishes losses and the absence of substantiated break-even routes under a consistent definition.
criteria.contradiction_condition: At least one unambiguously in-scope business has matching-period profitability under an identified matching accounting basis, or a substantiated break-even route existing at publication.
